name: Path of the Berserker
description: Turn battle fury into relentless offense through reckless, rage-fueled attacks.

3.name: Frenzy
3.description: Reckless Attack can add extra damage to the first Strength-based hit on your turn while Rage is active.

6.name: Mindless Rage
6.description: While raging, you are immune to Charmed and Frightened, and entering Rage ends either condition.

10.name: Retaliation
10.description: When a creature within 5 feet damages you, use your Reaction to make one melee attack against it.

14.name: Intimidating Presence
14.description: As a Bonus Action, force a creature within 30 feet to make a Wisdom save or be Frightened.

name: College of Lore
description: Collect broad expertise and turn sharp observation into a defense for your allies.

3.name: Bonus Proficiencies
3.description: Gain proficiency in three additional skills.

3.name: Cutting Words
3.description: Use Bardic Inspiration and a Reaction to reduce a nearby creature's successful attack roll, ability check, or damage roll.

6.name: Magical Discoveries
6.description: Learn two always-prepared spells from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell lists.

14.name: Peerless Skill
14.description: When you fail an ability check or attack roll, add a Bardic Inspiration die to the total.

name: Life Domain
description: Channel divine power toward restoration, endurance, and keeping wounded companions in the fight.

3.name: Disciple of Life
3.description: Healing spells cast with a spell slot restore additional Hit Points.

3.name: Life Domain Spells
3.description: Gain the level-appropriate Life Domain spells as always-prepared spells.

3.name: Preserve Life
3.description: Spend Channel Divinity to divide a pool of healing among Bloodied creatures nearby.

6.name: Blessed Healer
6.description: A slotted healing spell cast on another creature also heals you for 2 plus the slot level.

17.name: Supreme Healing
17.description: When you roll dice to heal, use the maximum value instead of rolling.

name: Circle of the Land
description: Draw adaptable magic and restorative power from the environment around you.

3.name: Circle of the Land Spells
3.description: Choose a land connection after a Long Rest to gain its always-prepared spells.

3.name: Land's Aid
3.description: Spend Wild Shape to harm nearby foes while restoring an ally's Hit Points.

6.name: Natural Recovery
6.description: Cast one Circle Spell free per Long Rest and recover limited spell-slot levels after one Short Rest.

10.name: Nature's Ward
10.description: Become immune to Poisoned and gain resistance tied to your current Circle land.

14.name: Nature's Sanctuary
14.description: Beasts and plants must make a Wisdom save to attack you.

name: Champion
description: Refine physical training into broader critical hits and stronger athletic performance.

3.name: Improved Critical
3.description: Weapon and Unarmed Strike attacks score a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

3.name: Remarkable Athlete
3.description: Gain Advantage on Initiative and Strength (Athletics) checks.

7.name: Additional Fighting Style
7.description: Gain a second Fighting Style feat.

10.name: Heroic Warrior
10.description: At the start of each combat turn, gain Heroic Inspiration if you do not already have it.

15.name: Superior Critical
15.description: Score a critical hit on a weapon/unarmed attack roll of 18-20.

18.name: Survivor
18.description: Regain 5 + Constitution modifier HP at the start of your turn if bloodied.

name: Warrior of the Open Hand
description: Control enemies with precise techniques delivered through Flurry of Blows.

3.name: Open Hand Technique
3.description: Flurry of Blows hits can prevent reactions, push a target, or knock it Prone.

6.name: Wholeness of Body
6.description: Use a Bonus Action to heal for one Martial Arts die plus Wisdom modifier, a limited number of times per Long Rest.

11.name: Fleet Step
11.description: When you use Step of the Wind, you can also use Patient Defense as part of the same Bonus Action.

17.name: Quivering Palm
17.description: Spend Focus Points to set up lethal vibrations in a hit target.

name: Oath of Devotion
description: Swear a formal oath centered on justice, duty, compassion, and honorable conduct.

3.name: Oath of Devotion Spells
3.description: Gain the level-appropriate oath spells as always-prepared spells.

3.name: Sacred Weapon
3.description: Spend Channel Divinity to empower a held weapon with divine accuracy and light.

7.name: Aura of Devotion
7.description: You and allies in Aura of Protection are immune to Charmed.

15.name: Purity of Spirit
15.description: You are permanently affected by Protection from Evil and Good.

20.name: Holy Nimbus
20.description: As an action, emit sunlight to deal radiant damage to enemies and gain saving throw advantages.

name: Hunter
description: Study dangerous prey and adapt your attacks to exploit the opening it gives you.

3.name: Hunter's Lore
3.description: Hunter's Mark reveals useful weaknesses, resistances, and immunities of the marked creature.

3.name: Hunter's Prey
3.description: Choose a specialized offensive technique and change that choice after a rest.

7.name: Defensive Tactics
7.description: Choose Escape the Horde or Multiattack Defense and change it after a rest.

11.name: Multiattack
11.description: You always have Conjure Barrage prepared and can cast it once for free per Long Rest.

15.name: Superior Hunter's Defense
15.description: Choose Evasion, Stand Against the Tide, or Uncanny Dodge subclass defense.

name: Thief
description: Turn speed, dexterity, and practical tricks into control over objects, locks, traps, and terrain.

3.name: Fast Hands
3.description: Use a Bonus Action for certain Sleight of Hand checks, Utilize actions, and eligible magic items.

3.name: Second-Story Work
3.description: Gain a Climb Speed and use Dexterity for longer jumps.

9.name: Supreme Sneak
9.description: Spend 1d6 of Sneak Attack to remain hidden when ending the turn behind sufficient cover.

13.name: Use Magic Device
13.description: You ignore all class, race, and level requirements on the use of magic items.

17.name: Thief's Reflexes
17.description: Take two turns during the first round of any combat.

name: Draconic Sorcery
description: Manifest durable draconic magic through protective scales, vitality, and inherited spells.

3.name: Draconic Resilience
3.description: Increase maximum Hit Points and gain a natural Armor Class formula while unarmored.

3.name: Draconic Spells
3.description: Gain the level-appropriate draconic spells as always-prepared spells.

6.name: Elemental Affinity
6.description: Choose an elemental resistance and add Charisma to one matching spell damage roll.

14.name: Dragon Wings
14.description: As a Bonus Action, manifest draconic wings to gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed.

18.name: Draconic Presence
18.description: Force nearby creatures to make a Wisdom save or be Frightened or Charmed.

name: Fiend Patron
description: Draw dangerous resilience and destructive magic from a bargain tied to the Lower Planes.

3.name: Dark One's Blessing
3.description: Gain Temporary Hit Points when an enemy falls nearby or by your hand.

3.name: Fiend Spells
3.description: Gain the level-appropriate Fiend Patron spells as always-prepared spells.

6.name: Dark One's Own Luck
6.description: Add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after seeing the roll, a limited number of times per Long Rest.

10.name: Fiendish Resilience
10.description: Choose a non-Force damage resistance after a Short or Long Rest.

14.name: Hurl Through Hell
14.description: Once per Long Rest when you hit a creature with an attack, banish it temporarily to deal 10d10 psychic damage.

name: Evoker
description: Specialize in shaping raw magical energy with efficient study and reliable damaging cantrips.

3.name: Evocation Savant
3.description: Add two eligible Evocation spells to your spellbook without paying their normal transcription cost.

3.name: Potent Cantrip
3.description: Damaging cantrips still deal partial damage when an attack misses or a target succeeds on its save.

6.name: Sculpt Spells
6.description: Protect selected creatures from your Evocation area spells, granting automatic saves and no damage.

10.name: Empowered Evocation
10.description: Add Intelligence modifier to one damage roll of each Wizard Evocation spell.

14.name: Overchannel
14.description: Maximize the damage of a Wizard spell of 1st through 5th level.
